name: Dissolution of the Silent Union
source:
Dissolution of the Silent Union is a short, narrative-driven visual novel where you accompany Vera, who is trapped on the last day of school, toward her inevitable date.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4530240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《无声同盟的解体》是一部以叙事为核心的短篇视觉小说。你将陪伴被困在学期最后一天循环之中的少女薇拉，一步步走向那场避无可避的约会。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4530240/]Steam[/url]]
